descriptions.A: a small, barren, and volcanic world, occasionally scarred by intense, toxic eruptions
descriptions.B: a small, molten world, occasionally the stripped core of a former gas giant
descriptions.F: a volcanic world with shallow seas
descriptions.H: a desert world with little liquid water
descriptions.I: an ice giant with a tilted magnetic field
descriptions.J: a gas giant with a turbulent atmosphere and rings
descriptions.O: an ocean world with most of its surface covered in liquid water
descriptions.R: a hothouse world, an oxygen-water world too hot and wet for its air to cool
descriptions.S: a barren, rocky Super-Earth, its surface molten when it orbits close to its star
descriptions.T: a gas dwarf with a thick atmosphere
descriptions.U: a methane-ethane world, with liquid methane and ethane under a thick, methane-bearing air
descriptions.X: an ammonia-water world, with an ocean of ammonia and water, often under an ice lid
descriptions.Y: a sulfuric acid world, with liquid acid under a sulfur-rich air
descriptions.Z: a hot world with thin air and no ocean

asteroid: an asteroid, a body too small for its own weight to pull it round
